policy.observations: midpoint-volume owner cubic endpoint secants, m2 footprints, endpoint-derived potential moments
policy.boundary: dynamic prescribed integrated outward scalar diffusion flux; frozen wall-envelope catalogue has zero flux
policy.invalid_legs: exclude each footprint having any RK4 stage or endpoint outside 0<u<1; independent seed masks, no batch retracing; no recipient cropping
policy.axis: collapsed origin face absent; regular-chart reconstruction and complete outer ring/eta incidence
policy.action: positive-coordinate flux divergence: plus contribution to lower owner and minus to upper owner
policy.reference: independent analytical face integral divided by continuous volume; bounded independent strong-volume checks
policy.acceptance: global physical-volume weighted L2 order >=1.8 per nonconstant field on both intervals; empirical reference fraction <0.1; structure/evolved separate
policy.trace_integrator: compiled CPU RK4, regular x/y and RK4 length
